16V244.component: OCS passenger-airbag campaign. FULL scope: 2016-2017 Maxima, 2013-2016 Altima/NV200/Leaf/Sentra/Pathfinder, 2014-2016 NV200 Taxi + Infiniti QX60/QX60 Hybrid/Q50 Hybrid, 2014-2017 Rogue + Infiniti Q50, 2015-2016 Murano/Murano Hybrid/Chevrolet City Express, 2014-2015 Pathfinder Hybrid, 2013 Infiniti JX35. Remedy DIFFERS: ACU+OCS ECU REFLASH on Altima/Maxima/Murano/Rogue/Sentra; OCS ECU REPLACEMENT on Leaf/NV200/NV200 Taxi/Pathfinder/Q50/JX35/QX60/City Express. Corrected 2026-08-03: the prior "NOT 2017+ and NOT Infiniti" exclusion was wrong on both halves.

10V036.component: Southeast Toyota load-carrying-capacity labels, 2006-2009 SIENNA ONLY (FMVSS 110). Cited in prose on toyota-highlander-2010 and toyota-4runner-2008 solely to state that it does NOT apply to those vehicles — do not add it as a recall entry on any non-Sienna slug.

15V246.component: Ford door-latch campaign (first of the 15V-246 / 16V-643 / 17V-210 / 20V-331 chain). Cited in prose on ford-escape-2013 only as the prior-repair population named by 20V-331; no standalone Escape entry.

17V210.component: Ford door-latch campaign (third of the 15V-246 / 16V-643 / 17V-210 / 20V-331 chain). Cited in prose on ford-escape-2013 only as the prior-repair population named by 20V-331; no standalone Escape entry.

18V551.component: Ignition switch can rotate out of RUN under key-ring weight/jarring — engine shutoff. Scope: 2017 NV200/Sentra/NV3500/NV1500/NV2500/NV200 Taxi/Chevrolet City Express + 2017-2018 Frontier, Versa Note, Versa Sedan — mechanical-key vehicles only. Added to nissan-frontier-2018 wave 17.

19V654.component: Back-up camera display settings retention, FMVSS 111 (~1.2M units). Scope: 2018-2019 Altima/Armada/Frontier/Kicks/Leaf/Maxima/Murano/NV/NV200/Pathfinder/Rogue/Rogue Sport/Sentra/Titan/Versa + Infiniti Q50/Q60/QX30/QX80; 2019 GT-R/Taxi + QX50/QX60/Q70/Q70L. Added to nissan-frontier-2018 wave 17. Also added to nissan-kicks-2019 wave 18 part 2.

12V395.component: Roadtrek MOTORHOME Thule awning-mount pop rivets may fail (2012). NOT an automotive light-duty campaign — was fabricated on nissan-frontier-2018 as 'Brake Booster' (a 2012 number on a 2018 truck), deleted wave 17. Do not add to any car/truck slug.

16V028.component: Autocar Xpeditor 2013-2016 dual-drive refuse trucks — air-brake cotter pin installation (1,028 units). COMMERCIAL TRUCK ONLY — was fabricated on bmw-3series-2018 ('Engine Compartment Cover') AND ford-mustang-2018 ('Axle Shaft'), cross-make collision, both deleted wave 17. Do not add to any car slug.

17V148.component: 2016-2017 Metris vans, 72 units, state-specific — Blind Spot Monitoring inoperative (wrong instrument cluster/steering wheel). METRIS ONLY — was fabricated on subaru-outback-2015 AND mitsubishi-outlander-2017 as 'PCV Valve', cross-make collision, both deleted wave 17. Do not add to any non-Metris slug.

17V224.component: 2.4L GDI engine bearing wear/seizure from factory machining debris (618,160 units): 2011-2014 Optima, 2012-2014 Sorento, 2011-2013 Sportage. KIA ONLY — was fabricated on nissan-sentra-2017 AND nissan-kicks-2019 as 'Seat Belt Anchor', deleted wave 17. Legitimately reusable ONLY on those Kia years (see CPO protocol files).

14V400.component: GM ignition-switch key-rotation campaign, 6,729,742 units: 2000-2005 Impala/Monte Carlo, 1997-2005 Malibu, 1999-2004 Alero, 1998-2002 Intrigue, 1999-2005 Grand Am, 2004-2008 Grand Prix. GM ONLY — was fabricated on nissan-pathfinder-2017 AND infiniti-qx60-2018 as 'CVT Cooler Contamination', deleted wave 17 (the real Pathfinder CVT-contamination issue is a TSB/class action, not this recall). Do not add to any Nissan slug.

22V714.component: Micro Bird BUS — loose power-cable connection. BUS ONLY — was fabricated on hyundai-ioniq5-2022 ('Battery Management Software') AND kia-carnival-2022 ('Brake Warning Indicator'), cross-make collision, both deleted wave 17. Do not add to any car slug.

17V253.component: Passenger frontal airbag inflator manufacturing error (non-Takata, non-deploy). Scope: 2015-2017 LEAF + 2014, 2016, 2017 Sentra. Remedy: inflator replacement.

21V135.component: Brake light switch contamination — lights may not illuminate. Scope: 2016-2019 Sentra. Nissan PM971. Remedy: switch replacement + protective grommet.

18V601.component: ABS actuator pump brake-fluid leak onto circuit board — electrical short / fire risk. Scope: 2015-2017 Murano, 2016-2017 Maxima, 2017-2018 Pathfinder, 2017 Infiniti QX60. Superseded/expanded by 19V-807.

19V807.component: ABS actuator — expansion and re-recall of 18V-601 (previously unrepaired or inspected-no-repair vehicles re-covered). Scope: 2015-2018 Murano, 2016-2018 Maxima, 2017-2019 Pathfinder + Infiniti QX60. Remedy: actuator replacement. Also added to infiniti-qx60-2018 wave 18 part 2 (cars.com 2018 QX60 feed lists 19V-807 as the sole campaign for that MY).

17V814.component: Instrument cluster may not display/chime PRNDL at key-off out of Park — rollaway (FMVSS 102/114). Scope: 2018 Mustang w/ auto trans + 12.4-inch digital cluster, ~2,100 units. Remedy: cluster software update.

18V213.component: 10-speed (10R80) transmission missing Park roll pin — loss of Park. Scope: 2017-2018 F-150, 2018 Expedition/Mustang/Navigator, 142 units. Remedy: inspection/repair.

18V465.component: Crankshaft sensor incorrect firmware — engine stall. Expanded 2018-09-12 to 5,309 units incl. 2018-2019 330i/330i xDrive/340i/340i xDrive (+ 2-/5-/7-series, X1/X2, MINI). Remedy: sensor replacement.

21V586.component: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump failure — stall. Scope: 2014-2018 328d/328d xDrive, X5 xDrive35d, 2014-2016 535d, 2015 740Ld, 2015-2017 X3 xDrive28d. DIESEL ONLY — do not cite on gas 3-series trims without the 328d qualifier.

21V907.component: Diesel EGR cooler internal leak — coolant + soot smolder, melting intake manifold, fire risk. Scope: 2013-2018 328d variants + 535d/740Ld/X3d/X5d. Includes all of 18V-755 (new remedy required); expanded again by 25V-700 (2025) for 2018 328d. DIESEL ONLY.

14V577.component: Accessory trailer hitch mounting nuts overtightened — stud failure / hitch detachment. Scope: 2015 Outback built 2014-01-22..2014-08-18 WITH Subaru accessory hitch. WQN-50. Remedy: replace all 8 nuts, inspect studs.

15V366.component: Brake light switch failure disables EyeSight pre-collision braking. Scope: 2015 Legacy/Outback/Impreza/XV Crosstrek + 2016 WRX w/ EyeSight. WQS-54. Remedy: driver-assist reprogram.

15V502.component: Propeller shaft yoke seal cap deformed — trans oil leak onto exhaust, fire risk. Scope: 2015-2016 Legacy/Outback built 2015-07-03..2015-07-27. WQU-56. Remedy: propeller shaft replacement.

16V251.component: Brake fluid excess moisture — ESC performance degraded (FMVSS 126). Scope: 2015 Legacy/Outback built 2015-07-20. WTC-64. Remedy: ABS activation + brake fluid flush/replace.

14V344.component: Mazda Takata regional passenger-inflator campaign (Mazda6/RX-8/MPV/Mazdaspeed6/B-Series; FL/PR/HI high-humidity). Was fabricated on nissan-sentra-2017 as "Takata Airbag (some builds)" — cross-make collision, deleted wave 18. The 2017 Sentra has NO Takata campaign; its real airbag recall is 17V-253 (non-Takata mfg error). Do not add to any Nissan slug.

14V787.component: Number could not be resolved to any real campaign via search. Was fabricated on subaru-outback-2015 as "Takata Airbag (Passenger)" — Subaru Takata scope is 2003-2005 Legacy/Outback/Baja + 2004-2005 Impreza only; the 2015 Outback has no Takata campaign and its complete NHTSA set (5 campaigns) does not include this number. Deleted wave 18. Do not add anywhere without primary-source resolution.

20V696.component: Number could not be resolved to any Subaru campaign via search. Was fabricated on subaru-outback-2015 as "Denso Low-Pressure Fuel Pump" — Subaru Denso pump campaign is 20V-218 and covers 2019 Impreza/Outback/Legacy/Ascent, not MY2015; the complete MY2015 Outback NHTSA set does not include this number. Deleted wave 18. Do not add anywhere without primary-source resolution.

18V755.component: Original BMW diesel EGR-cooler campaign (2013-2018 328d variants + 535d/740Ld/X3d/X5d). SUPERSEDED: all vehicles re-covered by 21V-907 with a NEW remedy — cite 21V-907 (and 25V-700 for 2018 328d), not this number, as the open campaign. Appears in prose on bmw-3series-2018 only as the superseded predecessor.

25V700.component: 2025 expansion of the BMW diesel EGR-cooler chain (18V-755 -> 21V-907 -> 25V-700): 2018 328d/328d xDrive incl. SportsWagon. EGR cooler internal leak, melting intake manifold, fire risk. Owner letters Dec 2025. Cited in prose on bmw-3series-2018 as the latest campaign in the chain.

17V609.component: Defective relays — engine stall / reduced power / overheating. Scope: 2015-2017 Outlander, 2015-2016 Lancer + Outlander Sport, 2015 Lancer Evolution. Campaign SR-17-005. Added to mitsubishi-outlander-2017 wave 18 part 2.
